exact_output.claim_level: B1-prime explicit R/F backend / fixed all-sigma braid closures

convention.calibration_note: R eigenvalues are oracle-calibrated to the repository's SU(2)_2 braid/Jones convention: sigma_1 closure gives sqrt(2), sigma_1^2 Hopf with sigma labels gives 0, and sigma_1^3 trefoil gives -sqrt(2).

examples.description: sigma_1 closure, isotopic to sigma-colored unknot
positive Hopf with both components sigma-colored
figure-eight with sigma color and +1 external framing

move_regressions.name: rf-r-r-inverse-cancellation
move_regressions.reason: local R followed by R^{-1} cancels

exact_output.not_scope: Omega expansion, mixed simple labels, arbitrary component colorings, n>3 fusion-path implementation, cup/cap boundary programs, special/dotted links, closed 4-manifold normalization, or exotic-pair computation
exact_output.scope: fixed-label all-sigma braid closures with at most three strands, evaluated by explicit R/F fusion-path matrices and categorical trace

notes: This is B1-prime: fixed all-sigma braid closures evaluated by explicit R/F matrices.
The SU(2)_2 braid oracle is used only as an external exact comparison backend.
